World of Warcraft Forever Dungeon Experience Buffed, but There's a Long Way to Go
World of Warcraft: Forever bumps dungeon XP from monsters by 50% after some community feedback I will diplomatically call passionate
Dungeons in World of Warcraft: Forever get a huge XP buff, but power-levellers shouldn't celebrate just yet

facts.key: at about 11 05 pst today we deployed a hotfix that increased kill experience in dungeons by 50 so it feels better to go back in for more runs
facts.value: At about 11:05 PST today, we deployed a hotfix that increased kill experience in dungeons by 50%, so it feels better to go back in for more runs,
facts.context: To try and soothe that ache, Blizzard's gone ahead and buffed the XP gain: "At about 11:05 PST today, we deployed a hotfix that increased kill experience in dungeons by 50%, so it feels better to go back in for more runs," writes community manager Kaivax.

singleSourced.context:
But there are also knock-on effects like fewer people feeling incentivized to roll tanks and healers, because those roles generally sacrifice open world leveling speed/efficiency for easier access to dungeons."

Meanwhile, user ACoolGuy-Promise just wishes Blizzard was more clear on the final numbers, saying, "They can’t say “X percent“ of classic values?
For instance, player Kassa posted, "I knew blizzard would cave," and then followed that up by posting, "and I knew even this buff wouldn’t be good enough for the complainers.

"Happy dungeon crawling, and good luck with those Deviate Hides!"

That 50% number isn't actually too much, mind—it's a 50% increase to the current value.
